::: {.body}
[dissertation · PPGRI/UFSC]{.kicker}

### China's technological rise in the world-economy

How China turns innovation capacity into a position in the global economic
hierarchy. It combines the world-systems and economic complexity literatures with
WIPO patent series and an automated literature review pipeline (OpenAlex,
deduplication, citation networks).

[Python · OpenAlex · NetworkX · patents · economic complexity]{.stack}

[data dashboard](https://china-innovation.vercel.app){.ref-link}
:::

### World trade in the nickel value chain and the RCEP

Data, pipeline and figures on world trade in the nickel value chain before and
after the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), based on the
BACI-CEPII database (HS2012, 2012–2024).
